dataset.selection_rule: First four distinct recording dates in September 2016 for Indy, earliest file per date; filenames only, no published decoder results consulted.

data.neural_feature: Sum all sorted and residual unsorted unit spike events per M1 channel; counts divided by observed bin duration. All 96 named M1 channels required in each file; no intersection or imputation.
data.time_selection: Start at t[0]; bin edges every 16 sample intervals; include only bins ending at or before min(t[-1],t[0]+300). Ignore the incomplete trailing bin.
data.coordinates: dataset cursor x,y; measured hand-controlled cursor
data.target_meaning: average velocity over the just-completed bin, available at its end; no forward prediction claim
data.eligibility: Retain first 3 complete bins per file with eligible=false and reason=causal-history warmup. Score every subsequent complete bin, including stationary periods.
data.admission: All selected prefix timestamps finite, strictly increasing, adjacent gap <=0.008000001s; selected cursor positions finite Nx2; exactly96 unique canonical M1 channels required; spike vectors finite/nondecreasing; minimum10 complete bins perfile. Any failure aborts the full comparison with all selected sessions listed; never replace or drop a file.

models.fit: One deterministic fit per model using only eligible source-day bins. No sweep, calibration, refit, tuning or adaptation.
models.ridge_objective: mean over training rows of squared 2D residual norm + lambda * sum(W**2); unpenalized intercept via source target centering.
models.scaler: Per-feature source-training mean and population std on the common eligible rows; zero std replaced with1. Stored unchanged for all evaluation sessions.
models.history: Current closed bin then preceding3 closed bins; session reset at each file; no cross-file state; no future neural bins.
models.label_boundary: Fit and save both models first. Generate and save all three sessions predictions from neural features only before reading ANY evaluation cursor_pos values. Evaluation labels are scorer-only.

comparison.delta: candidate minus baseline; positive is worse
comparison.purpose: prespecified offline engineering demonstration; results may subsequently be development evidence
comparison.pooled: sample-weighted secondary context only; all three sessions required
comparison.success: All selected files and models have content identities; all expected samples preserved; complete three-session comparison; independent arithmetic check and score reproduction agree. Candidate improvement or a regression is NOT required.

execution.environment: Ubuntu24.04 Python3.11, wheels-only NumPy2.2.6 h5py3.14.0; BLAS threads1
execution.evaluation_budget: One baseline/candidate comparison over3 fixed evaluation sessions. Deterministic verification is allowed; no outcome-driven reruns.
execution.artifacts: Keep raw recordings out of Git and CI upload. Preserve derived predictions, labels, model snapshots, protocol, receipt and report outside Git; commit aggregate results, hashes, source/environment identities and attribution.
execution.failure: Write a failure receipt listing all selected files. Preserve failed CI attempts. Transport retries allowed without changing selection; implementation repairs must be recorded and cannot change scientific choices.

limitations: One macaque; physical reaching, not a Neuralink participant or attempted cursor control.
Current-bin versus history models deliberately differ in input history and parameter count; no isolated causal attribution.
Offline reconstruction of measured movement is not closed-loop BCI efficacy or deployment validation.
No threshold for meaningful or statistically significant degradation is justified here; raw signed deltas are descriptive.
